paragraphs: inLogic sells RFID asset tracking software for organizations looking to streamline their asset tracking process. The product is RFTrack, a software platform that leverages RFID to help improve asset visibility by enabling organizations to automate fixed asset inventories, locate assets, and track the movement of assets in real-time. Delivery is described as turnkey, covering software, readers, tags and implementation services alongside the platform itself.

The about page frames two uses: automating an annual fixed asset inventory audit, and providing real-time visibility of assets. The homepage describes a commercial off-the-shelf platform that helps automate the process of tracking fixed assets for Education, Government, Defense, Aerospace, Research, IT, and Data Center customers. The about page lists Education, Government, Defense, Aerospace, Research, Manufacturing, and other organizations as the users the platform helps save time, reduce operating costs, and improve fixed asset visibility.

The about page says the company was founded in 2001 with a focus on developing data collection solutions, that its focus transitioned to RFID in 2004, and that its first RFID-based product was released in 2005. RFID is a data collection technology that uses radio frequency communication to collect data from RFID tags, which can uniquely identify objects such as assets or people.

quote.text: Our fixed asset tracking solutions help organizations leverage RFID to save time, reduce operating costs, and improve asset visibility.
